evidence.finding: A real Qwen3-4B trajectory produced a wrong answer with verbalized confidence 100%; subsequent V2 mapping prevents uncalibrated verbalized confidence from receiving low residual uncertainty or minting HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED evidence.

counterhypotheses: A calibrated probability/logit-derived estimator may support useful low uncertainty without excessive routing; current sample size is too small for controller promotion.
contradictions_preserved: Stable/confident model behavior is not correctness; recurrence readout remains proposal-only and not effect authority.
ancestry_rule: V1 receipt, confidence synthesis and V2 repair descend from one model-execution lineage and are correlated evidence, not independent replication.
